author: Tomas Weill
notes: Eight weeks closed, 420 sheets on file. The pressure-test line has read twelve pulled and none returned every week since 18 May.
Ran the notebook on the closed file for Ruth. It prints one window and calls it nine in ten.
The contact centre's June log came round the same morning: 361 outside the window of 1,842 with a window on the card.
Ruth wants the month's audit units put into night visits rather than left on the desk.
